narrative.overview:
A calm, orderly working desk for people who handle other people's generosity. The officer sits in front of records; letters are produced on letterhead; the Caritas maroon appears sparingly so that when it appears, it means "this is the action" or "this is where you are". The voice is calm, formal and precise: quiet surfaces, clear hierarchy, plain language, no playfulness. The interface is the workshop, and the letter is the product.

Density is moderate and consistent. Pages are white cards on a warm-grey canvas, fields are 36px tall, buttons are quiet, and every screen has one obvious primary action. Depth comes from thin borders first and shadow only when something floats.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-grey canvas, white bordered cards, one maroon action per view.
IBM Plex Sans throughout, small and steady type (12 to 14px in the app).
Borders before shadows; shadows only for floating things and the letter sheet.
The letter sheet is a separate artifact with its own size and type, not app UI.
Desktop-first: a 1000px minimum width, no mobile layout.

rules.name: The One Maroon Rule
rules.body: Maroon marks the single primary action per view, the active tab and links. It is never used as a background for large areas and never as decoration.

rules.name: The Editable Looks Editable Rule
rules.body: Only editable fields get the darker Control Stroke border. Saved data is shown as label over value with no box.

rules.name: The Letter Has Its Own Type Rule
rules.body: The letter sheet is set at 11pt body with a 1.5 line height, a 28px bold maroon "CARITAS MANILA" and a 9pt footer. These sizes belong to the printed document and never feed back into the app scale.

rules.name: The Borders Before Shadows Rule
rules.body: To separate a surface, add a Line Soft border first. Use a shadow only when the element visibly floats above others.

dos: Do keep one maroon primary action per view and use the Secondary style for everything else.
Do use the shared tokens (`brand-primary`, `border-border-soft`, `surface-soft-hover`, `text-text-secondary`) and the existing 36px control height before inventing new values.
Do mark non-document chrome with `no-print` so only the letter prints.
Do keep the letterhead out of a `<header>` element; the team's print CSS hides every `<header>`.
Do run Prettier (with the Tailwind plugin) on files you change.
donts: Don't use maroon for large backgrounds or decoration.
Don't add shadows to flat cards; add a border instead.
Don't resize the letter's type to fit the app scale, or the app's type to fit the letter.
Don't show editable and read-only values in the same style.
